title: Hoja de Diseño de Boutique de Ropa para Juego 3D con Vistas en Múltiples Ángulos y Desglose de Detalles
prompt: 3D game, chibi/cartoon style, main city area, boutique clothing store. The layout is divided into two main sections: The front view is centered and occupies about 50% of the space, showcasing the main exterior design. On the left side, include the side view and top-down view to present the overall shape and roof structure. On the right side, include the bottom-up view along with three breakdown diagrams of unique architectural details. The sheet should include multi-angle structural sketches, material references, and detailed callouts suitable for 3D modeling. Lighting should be soft, with a clean layout and high readability.
